items.headline: Special Weather Statement issued November 15 at 4:40AM AKST by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:

to take a more northerly track through the Bering Sea mid-week.

items.headline: Wind Advisory issued November 15 at 4:10AM AKST until November 16 at 6:00AM AKST by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Southeast winds becoming southwesterly 15 to 25 mph with
gusts up to 50 mph.

* WHERE...Prince of Wales Island.

* WHEN...Until 6 AM AKST Monday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Wind gusts will increase through Sunday, with
a wind shift southwesterly Sunday night.
items.instruction: Winds this strong can make travel difficult. Use extra caution.

items.headline: High Wind Watch issued November 15 at 3:58AM AKST until November 17 at 6:00AM AKST by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
* WHAT...West winds 50 to 65 mph with gusts up to 80 mph possible.

* WHERE...Shemya and Attu Islands.

* WHEN...From Monday evening through late Monday night.

* IMPACTS...High winds could move loose debris, damage property, and
cause power outages. Travel could be difficult.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Winds rapidly increase in strength late Monday
evening and peak Tuesday morning as a strong low pressure system
moves through the Bering. Winds will gradually lighten through
Tuesday afternoon.
items.instruction:
A high wind watch means there is potential for a hazardous high wind
event. Monitor the latest forecasts and warnings for updates on this
situation. Fasten loose objects or shelter objects in a safe location
prior to the onset of winds.

items.headline: Blizzard Warning issued November 15 at 2:46AM AKST until November 15 at 7:00AM AKST by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Blizzard conditions. Additional snow accumulations up to one
inch. Winds gusting as high as 60 mph through Sunday.

* WHERE...Central and Eastern Beaufort Sea Coast.

* WHEN...Until 7 AM AKST this morning.

* IMPACTS...Travel could be difficult. Snow and blowing snow could
reduce visibility below one half mile at times. Periods of blizzard
conditions will be intermittently possible.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Winds will remain elevated with gusts as high
as 60 mph on Sunday.
items.instruction:
